work.author: GregoBase
work.description: A contributor-maintained database of Gregorian chant scores in GABC notation, each chant page listing the printed books that carry it with their page numbers and the edit history of the transcription. A chant page carries the placements and the history; the GABC score itself is served by a separate request.
work.title: GregoBase, the database of Gregorian chant scores
